name: safemind-distributed
description: SafeMind Distributed - Sistema Distribuído de Avaliação Psicossocial e Gestão Ocupacional (Entrega 2)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AVALIACOES,CADASTROS" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w api-gateway" "npm run dev -w servico-avaliacoes" "npm run dev -w servico-cadastros"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api-gateway && npm run build -w servico-avaliacoes && npm run build -w servico-cadastros
